messages:
alex_pm: quick sync — we need to pick a prioritization for the next inference perf sprint. customer X is asking for both better p95 latency and lower token cost. can't do everything at once.

alex_pm: thinking we use a lightweight RICE pass + sequencing plan. propose: 1) KV prefix cache (fast win), 2) continuous batching/runner improvements, 3) quantized variants & muxing.

jordan_eng: agree on ordering in principle. curious on RICE numbers though — we should surface reach + measurable impact.

sam_ml: from model side: KV cache reduces repeated prefix compute 30-60% for our long-chat traffic (high reach). Continuous batching yields ~2-3x throughput for peak QPS but requires more infra effort. Quantization gives cost savings but risks quality regressions.

rita_sre: ops perspective: batch increases tail risk if not careful. we'll need circuit breakers and per-route SLO overrides. effort to add safe circuit is ~2 sprint-days + testing.

marta_cs: customer X details — they have heavy concurrent sessions (1000s of users) and complain about p95 spikes during peak. They're also sensitive to monthly token bill.

leo_sales: for renewal negotiation, we can promise a roadmap: low-effort latency work first (cache) and a later cost initiative. that buys us runway.

alex_pm: ok quick RICE sketch — please react if you disagree with the numbers, we can refine: 
```
Option A: KV prefix cache
Reach: 40k affected users/mo
Impact: 3 (improves p95 for many routes)
Confidence: 0.7
Effort: 4 dev-weeks
RICE ~ (40k * 3 * 0.7)/4 = 21000

Option B: continuous batching / runner improvements
Reach: 25k
Impact: 4 (throughput, cost per token drop)
Confidence: 0.6
Effort: 8 dev-weeks
RICE ~ (25k * 4 * 0.6)/8 = 7500

Option C: quantized model variants + muxing
Reach: 50k
Impact: 2 (cost)
Confidence: 0.5
Effort: 10 dev-weeks
RICE ~ (50k * 2 * 0.5)/10 = 5000
```

jordan_eng: those are reasonable starting points. I’d push to split Option B into B1 (batching at router level, low infra risk) and B2 (kernel-level optimizations, higher risk/effort). that will help staging and rollout.

sam_ml: +1 split. B1 might be 3-4 weeks, B2 another 4-6. B1 still gives meaningful throughput gains for small sequences.

rita_sre: for launch criteria propose:
- p95 improved by >= 25% on targeted routes (for cache/B1)
- no increase in error rate > 0.1%
- rollback plan with auto-failover to non-batched runner
- integration test that replays production traces at 2x QPS

marta_cs: customers will accept staged improvements if we commit to measuring impact and keeping them updated weekly.

leo_sales: add a commercial hook: if we can show 20% projected monthly cost reduction, we can offer a credit for the renewal.

alex_pm: now negotiation notes: engineering prefers cache -> B1 -> quant. product wants to balance latency (user experience) vs cost (sales asks). propose split-scope MVPs:
- MVP-1 (2 sprints): implement KV prefix cache for top 10 routes + basic metrics, no infra changes.
- MVP-2 (3 sprints): router-level batching + SLO guards, can opt-in per-customer.
- MVP-3 (6 sprints): model variant muxing + quantization experiments behind feature flag.

jordan_eng: that sequencing maps well to incremental risk. also suggests parallel work: while infra does B1, model team experiments on quantization offline.

sam_ml: reminder: quantization experiments need an eval harness and human review for quality regression risk. timeline depends on model family.

rita_sre: ops-bot: deploy-check requested for B1 when ready.

ops-bot: deploy-check queued. required checks: perf smoke, canary circuit test, error rate threshold.

alex_pm: final ask — can eng give estimate for MVP-1 and MVP-2 in story points by EOD? I'll run RICE with updated confidence and effort and share with GTM to align on customer comms.

jordan_eng: will do. aiming to break down tasks and point by tomorrow noon.

marta_cs: I'll draft a customer update template — simple status + expected benefits + timeline.

leo_sales: I'll delay renewal pitch until we have MVP-1 numbers so we don't overpromise. :thumbsup:

alex_pm: thanks all — we'll reconvene after estimates. keeping this thread for the decision docs and RICE numbers.

rita_sre: quick note — include chaos test in canary plan to catch perf regressions.

jordan_eng: noted. adding to the checklist.

sam_ml: posting a short perf-run script for reproducing the issue in staging:
```
# run 10k simulated sessions
python tools/sim_sessions.py --users 10000 --seq-len 512 --qps 200
```

alex_pm: perfect, that's helpful. closing for now — will post updated RICE and sequencing once estimates land. :rocket:
